commons.title: Chuonnasuan, the last shaman of the Oroqen, in July 1994 (Photo by Richard Noll).jpg
commons.description: This is a photo of Chuonnasuan (1927-2000), the last shaman of the Oroqen people, taken by Richard Noll in July 1994 in Manchuria near the Amur River border between the People's Republic of China and Russia (Siberia). Oroqen shamanism is now extinct.
commons.editorial_reason: Although the caption identifies an Oroqen shaman, the image is primarily a portrait of a named individual and does not visibly show traditional cultural dress, craft, or performance.
